Frequently Asked Questions

What will I learn from The Federal Benefits Gap?

You'll discover comprehensive strategies for maximizing your FERS pension, optimizing your TSP investments, making informed decisions about FEGLI life insurance, planning your FEHB health benefits for retirement, and understanding how Social Security integrates with your federal benefits. Most importantly, you'll learn about the critical gaps between what HR tells you and what you actually need to know for a secure retirement.

Who is The Federal Benefits Gap for?

This book is specifically written for federal employees, especially those within 10 years of retirement. Whether you're a GS employee, postal worker, or other federal worker, if you're confused about how your benefits work together or worried about making the right decisions at retirement, this book is for you.

Who is Michael Stevens?

Michael Stevens is a fiduciary financial advisor and the founder of Capital Wealth. He hosts the weekly radio show Retire Right Radio and is a guest speaker on local news networks. As a trusted voice for individuals and families navigating retirement, he's passionate about helping federal employees understand and maximize their benefits. He's served over 1,000 families as a fiduciary advisor.

When will The Federal Benefits Gap be available?

The Federal Benefits Gap is scheduled for release in 2026. Get your free chapter now and be the first to know when the full book becomes available at major retailers.

Is this book only for high-earning federal employees?

No! The strategies and insights in The Federal Benefits Gap apply to federal employees at all GS levels and pay grades. Whether you're early in your federal career or approaching retirement, understanding how to maximize your benefits package is crucial regardless of your current salary.
